fields.label: Rationale & Goals
fields.description: Why this matters and what observable success looks like.

fields.label: Scope / Out of Scope
fields.description: Explicit boundaries that prevent scope creep.

fields.label: API/UX Contracts (authoritative)
fields.description: Operations, payloads, examples, interface states, error behavior.

fields.label: Affected Modules / Files (authoritative map)
fields.description: Repository-relative paths this feature will touch or add. Avoid broad globs.

fields.label: Design Artifacts & References
fields.description: Durable links to designs, specifications, architecture documents, ADRs, related issues or PRs.

fields.label: Work Segmentation Plan (Human vs Agent)
fields.description: High-level split only. Detailed assignment happens in the Sub-Issue Index.

fields.label: Open Questions
fields.description: The canonical question log. Move resolved items under Answered.

fields.label: Architectural Impact / Data Model Changes
fields.description: New or changed components, schemas, relationships, indexes, caching, migrations.

fields.label: Non-Functional Requirements
fields.description: Measurable targets for performance, reliability, security, privacy, accessibility, scalability.

fields.label: Testing Strategy
fields.description: Unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, and security coverage, plus key scenarios.

fields.label: Known Risks & Mitigations
fields.description: 2-5 realistic risks, each with a concrete mitigation.

fields.label: Dependencies & Blockers
fields.description: Internal and external dependencies and sequencing constraints.

fields.label: Success Metrics & Observability
fields.description: Metrics that validate success and the signals used to observe them.

fields.label: Rollback Plan
fields.description: Concrete steps to revert, and any irreversible steps.

fields.label: Acceptance Criteria (feature-level only)
fields.description: 5-8 testable, outcome-focused checkboxes. Sub-issues carry their own criteria.

fields.label: Sub-issue Index (tasklist)
fields.description: Atomic stubs tagged [human], [agent], or [tbd]. Replaced with linked issues after decomposition.
